findings.title: Dependency-edge data are absent, so complete L/U localization is ineligible
findings.evidence: The final G7 input audit covers 92 cases and 23 theory families with no mock/demo inputs. The independently generated local-label audit reports edge_count_distribution={0:92} and eligible_u_cases=0; the final G7 run therefore contains no invented dependency edges and does not claim complete L-edge or U localization.
findings.remediation: Obtain an independently audited replacement proof-graph edge dataset with source hashes before enabling edge-level L/U claims; keep the present edge-free labels and G7 results as diagnostic-only evidence.

findings.title: G7 provider execution has terminal failures and low independently valid Q coverage
findings.evidence: The canonical 16-worker merge contains all 1288 planned fork IDs and all 184 checkpoint IDs, but only 993/1288 forks and 153/184 checkpoints completed; 295 fork rows and 31 checkpoint rows are terminal provider/checkpoint failures. Independent Q audit is 3 valid and 1285 invalid. These rows remain explicit failures in the canonical state views.
findings.remediation: Do not impute or relabel terminal failures. If confirmatory precision is required, run a separately frozen retry/replicate plan after diagnosing provider timeout/parse failure causes, with independent trace and Q review; do not pool it silently with this run.

resolutions.evidence: The corrected G6 runner profile g6_protocol_g3_tools_iteration was executed with exactly 2 workers on the verified 23-family denominator. The final G6 audit passes with 552/552 plan/response/trace rows, 1826 model requests, 1796 tool calls, no audit failures, and worker_counts=[2]; the independent release review is structurally passing and the corrected handoff is the only G7 input handoff.
resolutions.reason: Independent host tests and read-only G6 audit/release review verify the protocol repair; scientific release gates remain separate and blocked.

scientific_caveats: G6/G7 completion here means the prescribed execution, merging, auditing, and handoff artifacts were produced; it does not mean every provider row succeeded.
G7 diagnostic local-oracle interventions are not endogenous causal mechanisms and cannot support superiority claims.
All 92 cases have zero independently verified dependency edges and U is ineligible; no edges were fabricated.
G7 repeats=1 and terminal failures make the score exploratory rather than high-precision confirmatory evidence.
G8 selects no mechanism automatically; external trace, math, provenance, model snapshot, billing, and statistical review remain required.
